name: Cowper Zone ~Mise○y Fukou no Stalker no Hounyou Jigoku~
original_name: カウパーゾーン～ミザ○ィ・不幸の案内人の放尿地獄～
source:
Riku drifted through life without purpose or ambition. One day on the way home, he saw a strange shop. Curious, he went inside... and stepped into a world of hyper urine erotica... the Cowper Zone...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084103.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
里克漫无目的、毫无野心地浑浑噩噩度日。某天回家途中，他看到一家奇怪的商店。出于好奇，他走了进去……并就此踏入一个充满极端尿液色情的世界——“尿道球腺地带”……
